overview:
California's 38th District, redrawn to lean Democratic by about eight points, has no incumbent this cycle, and the fundamentals favor Democrats. Hilda Solis has raised more than one million dollars and drawn over three hundred thousand in outside support, while Republican Pedro Casas shows no reported fundraising. No independent polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district lean, money, and market pricing.

Prediction markets put the Democratic chance near ninety-four percent, and the fundamentals point the same way: the district's lean, a favorable environment, and a large financial advantage combine to an expected margin approaching twenty points. With no polling to check against, uncertainty stays wide, but every available signal favors Solis. The seat is rated Safe Democratic.
